BiblicalUsage: The word is purity, cleanness. Habakkuk says God's eyes are purer than to behold evil, and He cannot look on iniquity, so why does He look on them that deal treacherously, and hold His tongue when the wicked devoureth the man that is more righteous than he.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe God's pure eyes see everything, and the prophet's question is still ours when the wicked prosper.
